mapper.sql:
WHERE 1=1
AND a.warehouse_id = #{condition.warehouseId}
AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
AND a.status = #{condition.status}
AND a.is_danger = TRUE
AND ( p.handler_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.query}, '%') OR p.comment LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.query}, '%') OR p.item_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.query}, '%') OR w.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.query}, '%') OR u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.query}, '%') )

ORDER BY
a.created_at DESC
a.created_at ASC
a.created_at DESC
